subject: MAP: Technical evaluation — benchmarks, shortlist & SLA timeline
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@novahealth.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: MAP: Technical evaluation — benchmarks, shortlist & SLA timeline

Alex — great to meet earlier. This thread captures the technical-eval milestone from the MAP we discussed and lists concrete next steps so we have shared ownership and a target close. Attaching the MAP draft (PDF) and the benchmark spec worksheet.

Summary (actionable items):
- Goal: Validate model + infra choices for NovaHealth triage assistant (safety & latency sufficient for live use).
- Success criteria (pass/fail):
  - Accuracy/QA: top-line intent classification F1 >= 0.88 on your eval set + < 6% hallucination rate on sample prompts in tab "HF-Check".
  - Latency: < 120 ms p95 for 512-token flow on Dedicated instance profile; < 250 ms p95 on Hosted fallback.
  - Cost: average token cost target <= $0.004/token after batching and KV cache applied (projected workload).
- Model shortlist for benchmarks: Llama-3-13B (quantized), OpenAI-compatible baseline (for comparison), and a trimmed 7B variant for low-cost tier.
- Test plan owner: Rishi (benchmark harness + result upload)
- Deployment/runbook owner: Priyom (Dedicated config, KV cache, autoscale policy)
- SRE/contact for emergency: Marissa (on-call for infra regressions)
- External validation: NovaHealth provides 2 labeled prompt sets + 1000 anonymized traffic snippets (GDPR-sanitized).
- Target close for this MAP milestone: 2027-07-09 (final decision on model + SLA for pilot).

Requested from NovaHealth by 2027-06-22:
- 2 labeled sets (classification + hallucination probe)
- Confirmation of acceptable SOC2 evidence recipients (if you need specific docs attached)

Next steps (what I'll do):
- Rishi will spin the benchmark harness and share preliminary numbers by 2027-06-25.
- Priyom will draft Dedicated sizing and cost projection by 2027-06-28.
- I'll coordinate a short sync the week of 2027-06-28 to review results and finalize pilot SLA.

If any of the success criteria above need to shift, flag now — we want to bake in realistic targets so the pilot can move fast.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (MAP milestone table); benchmark-specs-novahealth.xlsx (columns: dataset, metric, p95 target, notes)

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@novahealth.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovaHealth Platform Team <infra@novahealth.io>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation — benchmarks, shortlist & SLA timeline

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the clear breakdown. Two quick clarifications from our side: we can deliver the labeled sets but need to confirm timelines with legal for the sanitized traffic export. Legal asked about what specific SOC2 artifacts you’ll need (scope? report date?). Can you confirm so we can route the request properly?

Latency: the <120 ms p95 on Dedicated sounds aggressive but aligns with our product goals. Can you confirm whether that number assumes colocated routing or multi-region fallbacks? Also — can the model shortlist include the 30B variant you mentioned in the call as an optional higher-accuracy arm for hard-fail flows? We want to see tradeoffs.

Proposed tweak: make the target close window a bit looser — can we move target close to 2027-07-16 if legal takes longer on data exports? We still want to keep momentum.

Happy to set a 30-minute follow-up once we have your SOC2 ask so legal and platform can triage.

—Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of Platform Integrations, NovaHealth
alex.morgan@novahealth.io

Quote from previous: "Goal: Validate model + infra choices for NovaHealth triage assistant..."

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@novahealth.io>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP: Technical evaluation — benchmarks, shortlist & SLA timeline

Alex — thanks, good questions. Quick answers and updated commitments below.

SOC2 / evidence: we typically share the SOC2 Type II report (redacted), control matrix, and a short onboarding checklist for what evidence third parties can expect. I'll attach a redacted SOC2 bundle to the shared Drive link and loop our security contact if legal wants a call.

Latency assumptions: the <120 ms p95 assumes Dedicated in us-west with colocated traffic routing (no cross-region hops). The hosted fallback p95 target (<250 ms) reflects multi-region routing and conservative queuing. We'll include both measured numbers in the benchmark sheet.

Model shortlist update: adding the 30B variant as an optional deep-eval arm is fine — we'll run it as a separate series and provide delta metrics so you can judge cost/accuracy tradeoffs.

Target close: we can move the MAP milestone target close to 2027-07-16 to accommodate legal. New timeline: decision on model + pilot SLA by 2027-07-16. Milestone owner responsibilities remain the same.

Owners and immediate actions (confirming internal owners):
- Rishi M. (benchmarks): deliver harness + baseline numbers by 2027-06-25; full report including 30B series by 2027-07-02.
- Priyom D. (deployment/runbook): Dedicated sizing + cost sheet by 2027-06-30.
- Marissa C. (SRE): quick-run incident playbook and contact roster by 2027-06-30.

Alex — I'll attach the SOC2 bundle to: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D/map-novahealth and will add a single-item DocuSign link if legal wants an NDA amendment.

Would you like a 30-minute sync Tue 2027-06-22 14:00 PT to confirm dataset delivery windows and legal touchpoints? If so I’ll send a calendar invite and include our security lead.

Best,
Naomi
